categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: Industrial Cleaning Systems and Surface Treatment, and Intelligent Equipment Manufacturing. The Industrial Cleaning segment includes general multi-piece cleaning, specialized single-piece cleaning, and precision cleaning, serving industries such as automotive (including new energy vehicles), machinery electronics, and medical. The Intelligent Equipment segment includes rubber intelligent equipment, digital factories, and electrical automation and integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced cleaning technologies including water-based cleaning, solvent cleaning, high-pressure cleaning, ultrasonic cleaning, pulse pressure cleaning, and plasma technology. It integrates automation and robotics, CNC technology, and Industry 4.0 applications in its manufacturing processes. The rubber intelligent equipment segment utilizes servo drives, pneumatic sealing, automatic correction, and digital operation systems. The company also develops alkaline electrolysis hydrogen production technology and digital factory logistics automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global automotive manufacturers, machinery electronics companies, medical device producers, and general industrial manufacturers. The company serves markets demanding high automation, cleanliness, and complex processes, including new energy vehicles, precision machinery, and medical sectors. Major markets are in Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific, with a strong presence in Germany, the US, China, and other countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with production bases, R&D centers, sales, and service centers in China, Germany, France, Switzerland, the United States, India, Mexico, and the Czech Republic. It maintains a global marketing network and leverages international subsidiaries to serve regional markets effectively.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying industrial cleaning equipment, surface treatment systems, and intelligent manufacturing equipment. It provides integrated solutions and services to OEMs and industrial manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in cleaning technologies, precision cleaning, and intelligent manufacturing equipment. The company invests heavily in R&D with over 300 patents and multiple global R&D centers. Key R&D projects focus on ultrasonic precision cleaning, medical cleaning technologies, electrolysis hydrogen production, battery bipolar plate cleaning, and intelligent vacuum drying modules. The company aims to enhance digitalization, modular design, and Industry 4.0 integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of industrial cleaning systems, surface treatment equipment, and intelligent manufacturing machinery. The company also earns income from customized engineering services, technical support, and after-sales services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels globally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a global leader and one of the few with a comprehensive international presence in industrial cleaning and intelligent equipment manufacturing. It competes with other high-end equipment manufacturers by leveraging advanced technology, global footprint, and strong brand recognition, especially through its Ecoclean brand in cleaning systems.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.36 billion, with a slight decline of 5.51% year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 21.76 million, showing a small increase in losses compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets were about RMB 1.88 billion, with a net asset value of RMB 853 million. Despite current losses, cash flow from operations improved significantly, indicating operational recovery efforts.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its technological leadership, global integrated solutions, and high-quality, customizable cleaning and intelligent manufacturing equipment. Its products offer high cleaning precision, automation, energy efficiency, and cost savings. The modular design and ability to upgrade systems ensure adaptability to diverse customer needs. The company’s global presence and strong R&D capabilities provide competitive advantages in innovation and market responsiveness.
